strongest_case: The two independent readings agree that v2d preserves the narrow exact-six-life, conditional interface-calibration estimand: the shared 514-call prefix and terminal-justified 0..72 THINK_0 calls precede q, complete selectors, measured balance, and D; PRIMARY_UNDEFINED preserves sunk evidence and suppresses every D-scaled branch; all three arms retain q_own as the outcome target under common logical randomness and unique physical identities; aliases/redaction, append-only provisional outputs, phase-A scorer absence, offline comparable controls and four metrics, shortcut reporting, and the unconditional Rohin stop prevent learning, oracle, population, or automatic-follow-up claims. They also agree that the exact sorted four-scope ratification, immutable identical review bundle excluding mutable intake.state.json, and the pinned eight-call zero-science H100 NVL envelope correctly repair the prior authority and feasibility defects. Every proposed acceptance test was audited: static/authority/preflight t_v2d_static_integrity_before_provider, t_v2d_scope_exclusions, t_v2d_zero_science_h100_provider_preflight, t_v2d_transitive_review_bundle_excludes_mutable_intake, t_v2d_exact_scope_claim_and_human_stop, t_v2d_exact_four_scope_phase_authority, and t_v2d_concrete_zero_science_envelope_resource; observed-basis, selector, no-leak, and ledger tests t_v2d_shared_514_and_think_prefix through t_v2d_exact_physical_logical_ledgers; and D-scaled phase/control/claim tests t_v2d_phase_a_raw_seal_unlock through t_v2d_phase_b_final_graph_and_done. No visibility leak, acceptance-test omission, H100 envelope defect, authority-order defect, D-accounting defect, or human-stop escape was found in those contracts. One graph-order omission below is nevertheless material: the added exploratory-ceilings node has no predecessor, so the graph itself fails to encode its mandated defined-life-after-branch condition. Proceed must remain blocked until that exact graph byte is repaired and the dependent interpretations are regenerated.

concerns.statement: The proposed graph leaves v2d_defined_life_exploratory_ceilings without an inbound edge. Its sole listed edge is v2d_ceilings_to_phase_a, so the graph does not require exploratory ceilings to follow a successfully defined branch. This contradicts the node text ("for each defined life only"), the experiment specification (exploratory calls execute only for defined lives after their branches), and the intended D-scaled schedule. A disconnected added node can be scheduled before definition, after PRIMARY_UNDEFINED, or independently of branch completion despite the prose and future test saying otherwise.
concerns.evidence: change.json graph_delta adds v2d_defined_life_exploratory_ceilings and adds only v2d_ceilings_to_phase_a from that node. No edge targets it: v2d_balance_to_branch reaches v2d_three_arm_crn_selector, and v2d_selector_to_dream reaches v2d_ascii_alias_provisional_dream, but neither reaches the ceilings node. experiment_spec.md states both that undefined lives receive no full-context/RAG call and that exploratory calls execute only for defined lives after their branches. The systems and scientific interpretations both describe that same intended order, so their agreement exposes a proposal-graph omission rather than resolving it. Repair change.json by adding one precedence edge, for example v2d_branch_to_defined_life_exploratory from v2d_ascii_alias_provisional_dream to v2d_defined_life_exploratory_ceilings, whose after text requires exactly one full-context plus sixteen RAG calls only after all 48 branch calls for each D-defined life have frozen; retain v2d_ceilings_to_phase_a. Then regenerate the change hash, both interpretations, critique, consensus, and ratification path before any implementation or provider activity.
